result.title: Direct Feedback Policy Optimization for AI Coding Agents
result.summary: AI coding agents generate, modify, and validate code through multi-turn interactions. Existing reinforcement learning methods often rely on sparse terminal rewards, making it difficult to assess how intermediate decisions affect task outcomes, and group-relative methods also require repeated sampling for each task. We propose Direct Feedback Policy Optimization (DFPO), a single-trajectory reinforcement learning algorithm that trains directly from a single trajectory. DFPO achieves higher task resolution rates than GSPO under matched base models and execution harnesses.

AI.brief_summary: DFPO 提出一种单轨迹强化学习算法，用于多轮交互的 AI 编程 agent 训练，旨在缓解稀疏终止奖励下难以判断中间决策贡献、以及组相对方法需重复采样的问题，并报告在匹配基座与执行环境下任务解决率高于 GSPO。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「单轨迹训练＋中间步骤贡献分配」思路可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理轨迹的训练与贡献分配提供借鉴线索；但对象为纯代码 agent，不涉及视觉状态，具体机制可供核查。
